purpose.zh: 练肩膀深层的小肌肉，让肩更稳
purpose.en: Build the small deep shoulder muscles for a steadier shoulder.

text.zh: 手肘贴身弯成直角，小臂往肚子转
text.en: Keep your elbow bent at your side and turn your forearm in to your belly

text.zh: 侧对固定点站直，膝盖微弯。
text.en: Stand tall side-on to the anchor with soft knees.

text.zh: 停住几秒，再慢慢转回去。
text.en: Hold for a few seconds, then turn back slowly.

commonErrors.en: Letting your elbow drift away from your side.
Turning your body instead of your arm.

cautions.zh: 固定点不牢时先别开始
cautions.en: Do not start until the anchor is secure.

cautions.zh: 肩膀疼时减小幅度或停下
cautions.en: If your shoulder hurts, make the move smaller or stop.

changes: 名字去掉「肩内旋 / Internal Rotation」术语
动画 1 下/8 s、停约 4.6 s，每侧 12 次改 8 次
「肩袖」改成「肩膀深层的小肌肉」
flags: 每下停约 4.6 s 偏慢；改了动作名，请确认
